name: False Reflection Kami
lore: The Gate creates a false mirror of the player's deity and asks which is real. The False Reflection wears the deity's shape but is made of void-mist. Its mirror-surface reflects distorted versions of everything around it. The reflection in the black water below moves independently.
visualDescription: 50-60ft Hollow entity in deity-shaped mirror form. Reflective void-mist surface. Floating broken mirror shards. Corrupted torii gate frame. Black water pool with independent reflection. Gate stone in chest.
mapBehavior: Boss encounter — 4 phases: mirror attacks, clone creation, buff theft, mirror shatter
